items.text: The figure wears blue denim-coloured trousers that are fitted at the hip and flare wide from the knee down to the hem (bell-bottoms)
The figure wears a mustard/yellow long-sleeve shirt with a large collar over an open V neckline, worn untucked over the trousers
The panels show the same dressed figure standing, walking, seated with thighs horizontal, and with arms raised out to the sides
In no panel does bare skin of the body poke through the trousers or the shirt fabric
No garment shows torn holes, long pointed spikes, or detached floating pieces
